sloka: अजीवनार्हेण मया नृशम्सा ।कृता प्रतिज्ञा नियमेन तावत् ।त्वया हि बाल्यात् प्रतिपन्नमेतत् ।त्न्माम् दहेद् वेणुमिवात्मपुष्पम् ॥२-३८-७॥
transliteration: ajīvanārheṇa mayā nṛśamsā ।kṛtā pratijñā niyamena tāvat ।tvayā hi bālyāt pratipannametat ।tnmām dahed veṇumivātmapuṣpam ॥2-38-7॥

translations.english: By giving this cruel promise through importunity, I have rendered myself unfit to live. This promise was made as a child's play and it (now) destroys me like a bamboo destroyed by its own flowers.
